sources.snippet: A fundamental pattern we have seen with gen-erative AI is interfaces that are iterative and allow users to adjust their aims in subsequent iterations. This represents a shift away from the deterministic and rigid command-and-control model to one where interactions are more conversational, iterative, and adap-tive.
